tasks.title: Deliver human-first application capabilities and metadata editing with original recovery

Show meaningful application/environment/definition names and real versions first; preserve exact opaque IDs in collapsed technical details/copy. Keep existing application/instance/list/panel context and truthful absent/conflicting/stale/unsupported states. tasks.validation: Compare the exact approved current previews; test projection, technical detail/copy/focus and protected state lifetime. Reuse native auth/Management and desktop fixture to prove actual capabilities, metadata ETag race and lost-response/reload original recovery, direct BFF authorization/CSRF/session/grant failure, keyboard and no clipping. Document metadata/recovery and capability-version meaning. Include meaningful focused native/unit or browser checks for this implementation, affected documentation, and proportionate independent review; preserve failures and actual joined cleanup. Do not turn authored tests or reused evidence from different source bytes into a pass. Verify this owner consumes only the declared medium prerequisites (WORK-151, WORK-152, WORK-153, WORK-155, WORK-156, WORK-157) and keeps the original parent accounting pool; broad provenance containers are not early completion prerequisites.
